title: 10 Best Persea Americana Preparations

Teas made from the leaves or fruit are commonly used to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. Decoctions involve simmering the bark or roots to extract potent compounds for respiratory and skin conditions. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb for internal use, while mucillages, derived from the fruit pulp, are used as soothing demulcents. Oils extracted from the seeds or leaves are valued for their emollient properties in topical applications.
